Name: Island Secret
Author: eduanttunes
Description:
[center]There is a hidden secret map in Ginger Island. This mod allows you to teleport there!

I've found a file named "Island_Secret.xnb" on Stardew Valley game files. This map is not loaded directly into game, so the mod will load it.

Press the "G" key to teleport there and start the exploration. You can change this key on config.json.

[color=#ffff00][u][b]It is a vanilla unused content. Let's make theories about it? :D[/b][/u][/color]

[spoiler]
You can see some interesting things on this Island: Birdies' hut, a possible Leo' treehouse, banana shrine and a hidden golden walnut on a bush.
Probably the story would be different and this map was left off.

[/spoiler]

Credits: [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/eduanttunes]Edu Anttunes[/url]﻿[/b]

Requires SMAPI, TMXL and PyTK.[/center]
